confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use Singapore cost-of-living aggregates, with the cocktail indicator updated in October 2026. Wine is estimated at about 1.5 times the local draft-beer price because comparable glass-of-wine data were sparse. Lodging is a holistic estimate from general knowledge; no accommodation prices or live listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; Singapore city-level price aggregates guided food and drink, while lodging was estimated holistically for Singapore.
